description: This HTML file serves as a demo page for the CodeMirror 'runmode' functionality, showcasing how to apply syntax highlighting to XML code outside of the CodeMirror editor, using external scripts and demonstrating the use of runmode.js with an XML mode.

methods.name: doHighlight
methods.description: Triggers the syntax highlighting of the code contained in the textarea using the specified mode ('application/xml') and outputs the highlighted tokens into the designated output element.
